meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: A fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback that enables AI agents to navigate, click, type, and snapshot pages via structured commands.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用结构化命令自动操控浏览器页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在无头浏览器中自动执行点击、输入和截图操作。
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser pages with structured commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate clicking, typing, and snapshotting in a headless browser.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动控制浏览器：打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、录制视频等。它会用命令行工具执行这些操作，并返回页面内容或截图结果。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 自动操作网页（如填写表单、抓取数据、测试界面）时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图保存。
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并保存截图文件。

say.text: 帮我登录网站，然后保存登录状态。
say.note: Claude 会填写表单、点击登录，并保存会话状态。

say.text: 搜索“天气”并返回第一条结果的标题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser: open pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, record videos, etc. It uses a command-line tool to perform these actions and returns page content or screenshots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to automate web interactions, such as filling forms, extracting data, or testing UIs.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a screenshot file.

say_en.text: Log in to the site and save the session state.
say_en.note: Claude will fill the form, click login, and save the session.

say_en.text: Search for 'weather' and return the title of the first result.
